title: Days in a month with leap years
description: Feature request for the calendar helper that returns the number of days in a month of a given year (years are 1 or more, months are numbered 1 to 12). Today February always has 28 days. Make it handle leap years: a year is a leap year when it is divisible by 4, except that century years (divisible by 100) are not leap years unless they are also divisible by 400. February of a leap year has 29 days. Everything else stays as it is: a month outside 1 to 12 is an error with the message "invalid month"; April, June, September and November have 30 days; the other months have 31.
notes: Feature: the three-part leap rule (4 / 100 / 400). Start returns 28 for every February. Hidden tests cover 2024, 2000, 2400, 4 (leap) and 1900, 2100, 2023, 1 (not leap). Visible examples pass on the start.
